title: Matrix-Free Photoacoustic Image Reconstruction via Sensor-Token Self-Attention
authors: Mary John; Shibili Said; Imad Barhumi; Sherzod Turaev; Mohamed Yahia
matched_query: photoacoustic tomography sparse-view reconstruction sensor-token self-attention matrix-free

summary_en: Introduces Sensor Attention Network (SAN), a Transformer that treats each PAT sensor time series as a token and reconstructs the initial pressure image directly from raw sparse-view measurements. The method removes system-matrix use at inference and reports improved reconstruction metrics and substantially faster inference than the tested iterative and learned baselines.

title: Simulation-Based Imaging: Learning Acoustic Inverse Problems from Simulated Data
matched_query: simulation-based acoustic imaging inverse problems simulated data boundary pressure reconstruction
reasons: learns 3D interior reconstruction from simulated boundary pressure measurements
official arXiv record verifies title, authors, date, and technical abstract

summary_en: Presents a simulation-trained acoustic inverse-imaging framework in which a discontinuous-Galerkin forward solver generates training measurements and a neural model reconstructs a 32×32×32 interior volume from boundary pressure data. The proof-of-concept reports robustness to measurement noise and substantial sensor-count reduction.
